PC: Place defibrillation pads on patient immediately
Give an appropriate antidysrhythmic medication (amiodarone, procainamide, lidocaine, or beta-blocker)
Give a second appropriate antidysrhythmic medication (amiodarone, procainamide, lidocaine, or beta-blocker)
Administer synchronized cardioversion when patient becomes unstable
Order labs including troponin and electrolytes
Monitor oxygen saturation and telemetry during cardioversion
Obtain a repeat EKG after cardioversion
MK: Recognize wide complex tachycardia on EKG
ICS: Explain cardioversion to patient prior to shocking
